title: Customer onboarding sprint gates and quality safeguards
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Objective: Define a concise, enforceable set of sprint gates and quality safeguards to verify readiness for initial customer onboardings (pilot cohort and first wave of paid activations). Scope covers cross-functional checks across Product, Eng, Design, Solutions, Support, and GTM. Outputs: a launch gate checklist, automated telemetry/health checks, release notes coordination template, support runbook excerpt, and a risk rollback playbook.

Why this ticket: Recent pilots revealed gaps between engineering sign-off and operational readiness (missing alerting for token-cost regressions, incomplete release notes for breaking API changes, and unclear support-escalation paths). This initiative closes those gaps by turning implicit signoffs into discrete, testable gates enforced at sprint boundaries.
outcomes: A standard sprint-gate checklist used by all teams for customer onboardings
Automated telemetry smoke tests in staging that map to acceptance criteria
A release-notes and GTM coordination template for PMs and Marketing
Support and SE runbook with ROT (runbook of tests) for customer-facing issues
Defined rollback / fallback triggers and responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: Gate checklist has at least 12 discrete checks covering API, performance, security, docs, and support
Each check maps to an owner and an observable (metric, log, or runbook step)
Two automated smoke tests added to CI that fail the gate if regressions occur (latency P95 > SLO or token-cost per request > 1.5x baseline)
Release notes template includes backward-compatibility section and a one-line migration summary
Support runbook published and validated with a mock escalation during the readiness demo
tasks: PM: Draft initial gate checklist and circulate to Eng/Design/Support (owner: Priya)
Eng: Implement two staging smoke tests (latency and token-cost) and wire alerts (owner: Jordan Lim)

Solutions/SE: Create a basic onboarding playbook for first-10 customers (owner: Lara Ortiz)
Docs: Populate release-notes template and publish to internal drive (owner: Ahmed Khan)

GTM: Plan comms cadence and finalize customer-facing migration copy (owner: Hannah Li)
Ops: Define rollback trigger thresholds and a fast-fail runbook (owner: Ravi Patel)
risks: Automated checks may give false positives during burst traffic — plan a quarantine/override flow
Incomplete telemetry mapping for new model variants could hide regressions
Cross-team alignment risk if owners do not commit by W2 of the cycle
mitigations: Add a human-in-loop bypass with mandatory post-mortem for overridden gates
Prioritize telemetry instrumentation for model variants used by pilot cohort
Weekly cross-functional readiness syncs (15m) to track open items and blockers
